name: Ask In Jesus Name
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are invited to ask in prayer with faith, confidently expecting that God will answer according to His will, as seen in Matthew 21:22 and Mark 11:24. Jesus emphasizes that asking in His name is the means by which the Father is glorified, assuring that requests made in His name will be granted (John 14:13-14). This promise is rooted in the believer's abiding relationship with Christ, where His words dwell within them, enabling them to ask according to His will and receive answers (John 15:7). Ultimately, Jesus is the exclusive way to the Father, underscoring the necessity of approaching God through Him when making requests (John 14:6).
